Maria: Quick sync — gating items for the dedicated capacity launch next week. Who has ownership for the remaining blockers? Need owners for: GPU ETA, network CIDR/KMS, reservation commit, and terraform review. Can we list owners and next actions? :white_check_mark:

Sam: I own GPU procurement. H100 batch currently held at customs (NJ). Carrier updated ETA Tue 2026-03-25. Working with procurement to clear docs. Tracking: https://carrier.example/track/PR-9844 :fingers_crossed:

Alex: Platform: reservation draft created in portal (res-2026-03-20-23). Need final instance count to lock commit and cost. If anyone changes counts pls ping. I also pushed a small terraform snippet to the PR.

Alex: ```hcl
resource "redwood_reserved_capacity" "dedicated_pool" {
  reservation_id = "res-2026-03-20-23"
  gpu_type       = "h100"
  count          = 12
  region         = "us-east-1"
}
```

Jen: SRE/network: Network prep items: confirm CIDR for private subnet and KMS key for node pool encryption. We currently have 10.40.0.0/20 reserved but that collides with customer VPC in staging unless we shift. Need KMS alias and service account names. @Sam can you confirm KMS key?

Sam: KMS key arn is `arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789:key/abcd-efgh`. I'll verify with security and attach the ticket. Procurement ticket #PR-9844 — I'll update with customs docs and ETA.

infra-bot: reservation-service: reservation job queued -> id=r-73a, reservation=res-2026-03-20-23, status=pending

Maria: Terraform PR is #4156 in infra repo — changes: reserved_capacity resource, instance profile + ip allocation. Needs review from @Sam and @Alex. Can we get reviews today? Also confirm rollback plan if GPUs delayed.

Alex: I'll review PR #4156 today EOD. Note: if H100s delayed >72h we should activate burst fallback to A100-small. Suggest adding routing policy fallback (low-cost) — draft at /docs/runbooks/capacity-fallback.md.

Jen: Monitoring owners: we need two alerts before launch: `infra.capacity.utilization` and `gpu.warmup.failures`. I can add them if you confirm owner for alert action (pager vs slack). Recommend: pager for gpu.warmup.failures, slack for infra.utilization initially.

Sam: ack. Owners: GPUs -> Sam (procurement + customs), Reservations -> Alex (portal + commit), Networking/KMS -> Jen, TF review -> Alex & Sam, Monitoring -> Jen. I'll open an eng-infra follow-up to attach customs docs.
